description: The first CLI for Peekaping: full monitor CRUD plus offline down/flapping/uptime analytics no single API call can answer.

novel_features.name: Down services
novel_features.description: List every monitor that is currently down, each enriched with its latest failure message and ping.

novel_features.name: Flapping detection
novel_features.description: Rank monitors by how often they flip state (up/down) over a window, surfacing the noisiest services.

novel_features.name: Worst uptime / SLO breach
novel_features.description: Rank the whole fleet by uptime percentage for a window, or filter to monitors below an SLO target.

novel_features.name: Cert expiry
novel_features.description: List TLS certificates expiring within a window across all HTTP monitors, sorted by days remaining.

novel_features.name: Incident timeline
novel_features.description: A chronological log of state-change events across monitors, or one monitor's recent failures.

novel_features.name: Tag-level reliability
novel_features.description: Roll up uptime and down counts grouped by tag, e.g. prod vs staging.
